players.product: Turnkey custom-chip (ASIC) design and mass-production services for AI/data-processing chips, plus licensed GPU, GPGPU, NPU and VPU processor IP

quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing, pre-collected answer): it has positions in satellite communications, embodied intelligence and brain-computer interfaces, providing core semiconductor IP and chip customisation; on its FD-SOI low-power technology it keeps developing platforms for Wi-Fi 6, BLE 6, satellite communications and millimetre-wave radar; many customers have licensed its core IP for AI edge computing in robot vacuums, cars, security surveillance, AI glasses, drones and action cameras, expanding into AI toys and embodied intelligence; and its VeriHealthi solution has provided ASIC custom design of invasive brain-computer-interface chips and capsule-endoscope chips to several customers worldwide. Chairman and CEO Dai Weimin defined the order backlog as signed orders not yet converted into revenue and new orders as orders signed in the period.
